title: Wi-Fi
description: Adds a Wi-Fi network so the device joins it without typing the password. Enterprise (802.1X/EAP) networks are not supported in this editor yet.

SSID_STR.title: Network name (SSID)
SSID_STR.description: Exact name of the Wi-Fi network.

HIDDEN_NETWORK.title: Hidden network
HIDDEN_NETWORK.description: On if the network does not broadcast its name.

AutoJoin.title: Join automatically
AutoJoin.description: Off makes the user tap the network to join it.

EncryptionType.title: Security type
EncryptionType.description: WPA allows WPA and WPA2; WPA2 allows WPA2 and WPA3; Any also allows WEP.

Password.title: Password
Password.description: Wi-Fi password. Stored in the profile.

DisableAssociationMACRandomization.title: Turn off private Wi-Fi address
DisableAssociationMACRandomization.description: On uses the real MAC address on this network; Settings shows a privacy warning. iOS 14+.

CaptiveBypass.title: Skip captive portal detection
CaptiveBypass.description: On stops the login sheet for captive networks. iOS 10+.

ProxyServer.title: Proxy server
ProxyServer.description: Host name or IP address. Manual proxy only.

ProxyPassword.title: Proxy password
ProxyPassword.description: Manual proxy only. Stored in the profile.

ProxyPACFallbackAllowed.title: Connect directly if the PAC file is unreachable
